<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**6** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS), inlineTitle (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS; a string literal in lookupObjectFieldAttr))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_
- `content/docs/getting-started/quick-reference.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via relatedListTitle (symbol, a field of interface ObjectFieldLike), relatedListTitle (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS; a string literal in collectExpectedEntries; a string literal in lookupObjectFieldAttr; a string literal in translateObject))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via ObjectFieldLike (symbol, a top-level interface), inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-2.mdx`  _(via inlineHelpText (literal, a string literal in FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **179** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9049be26ad6cbfbf9a87ee8fa0fd2666ead200fc` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2b851ef9a0f7eb62b7deff2e9b878cd5df83c58c` — the merge of head `a2ca53a2eab3155f6001717bb6c7e3b7647b0da8` into base `9049be26ad6cbfbf9a87ee8fa0fd2666ead200fc`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2b851ef9a0f7eb62b7deff2e9b878cd5df83c58c && git checkout 2b851ef9a0f7eb62b7deff2e9b878cd5df83c58c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9049be26ad6cbfbf9a87ee8fa0fd2666ead200fc a2ca53a2eab3155f6001717bb6c7e3b7647b0da8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9049be26ad6cbfbf9a87ee8fa0fd2666ead200fc && git merge --no-ff a2ca53a2eab3155f6001717bb6c7e3b7647b0da8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9049be26ad6cbfbf9a87ee8fa0fd2666ead200fc
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9049be26ad6cbfbf9a87ee8fa0fd2666ead200fc` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a2ca53a2eab3155f6001717bb6c7e3b7647b0da8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json, packages/spec/api-surface/system.json, packages/spec/export-origins/system.json, packages/spec/liveness/translation.json, packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/translation.md, docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/system.md, packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts (`pushOptional`, :1504), packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts (:316 `field` bucket), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-translated-echo.ts (`FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS`, `restoreTranslatedEchoes`), packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts (`translateMetaList` :3024), packages/rest/src/meta-app-bundle-routes.ts (docblock :16-21), packages/client/src/index.ts (:7836 `Accept-Language`), ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/deriveRelatedLists.ts (:356-390), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx (:2245, :3906, :3995-4048), ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx (:551), ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts (:937, :961-990), scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json, scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs (one-sided ratchet), skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md (:162), the precedent merge 4f05de4b (PR #26757), card #29942 body and 4 comments, PR #29989 body and 13-file diff, 62 check-runs on the head.

Gate verdicts on a2ca53a2 at read time: 24 success (Auto Label, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Flag docs affected, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, PR-body guards, Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, filter, and the Lint / Type Check rows that had completed), 8 skipped (opt-in harnesses, Dogfood shards, Temporal Conformance, UI Published Artifacts, Schedule gate), 0 failure. Still running: Build Core, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core 1-8, Test UI 1-16, Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · workspace. No gate has red on this head; the verdict below stands subject to those 30 finishing green.

### ① Derived judgments

- `FieldTranslationSchema.relatedListTitle` (optional `z.string()` on a `strictObject`): a widening of a published accept set, named right (`Clause-②: yes`). Before it, `TranslationDataSchema.safeParse` refused the key with `unrecognized_keys`; after it, the key parses at the bundle door and the per-object door (test pins both). No alias is added, which matches `inlineTitle`.
- `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json` gains `system/FieldTranslation:relatedListTitle` beside `:inlineTitle`: right, the exact row the precedent 4f05de4b added for `inlineTitle`.
- `api-surface/system.json` and `export-origins/system.json` not moved: right. Both list exports by name; the precedent moved them only for its new `ReportBlockLike` export. This diff exports nothing new; `ObjectFieldLike` gains a property but is listed as `ObjectFieldLike (interface)` by name only, and `api-surface-signatures.json` does not carry it.
- `liveness/translation.json` and `state-counts/translation.md` not moved: right. The precedent's 36 to 38 was the `reports.blocks` container plus two children; `inlineTitle` got no row, and the `objects` row's note lists field slots as prose only (it still stops at `fields.{label,help,placeholder,options}`, a pre-existing staleness this PR does not owe).
- `docs/audits/…counts/system.md` not moved: right. The ledger counts object sites (`strictObject` nodes); the precedent's 383 to 384 was its new block-translation node. A key on an existing node adds no site.
- `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`: two generated rows, one per place `FieldTranslation` is rendered. Right.
- `ObjectFieldLike.relatedListTitle` and the `lookupObjectFieldAttr` attr union widened: internal type widening, no runtime refusal moves. Right.
- `FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS` in metadata-protocol gains the key: a widening of what the save door restores, not of an accept set. Right, and owed, since the translator now writes the slot.
- `i18n-extract.ts` emits the key only where authored (`pushOptional`, kind `field`); `i18n-coverage.ts` maps `field` to the `field` bucket at :316 with no edit, as claimed. Right.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/cli` minor, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor. Kind `Metadata-protocol: added` takes at least minor on every package the diff moves; all three move, and the showcase (`@objectstack/example-showcase`) is `private: true`. Right.
- `Clause-②: yes` with no arm, in the PR body and the changeset body (line-initial, both). AGENTS.md §3 makes the arm optional (`at most one arm`), and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` :2323 reads `(widening)` as `if you like`. `Check Changeset` is green. Right.
- `Metadata-protocol: added`: a new key an author can write, the right word of the closed set.
- ADR-0087: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Correct: a disposition marker is owed on breaking changesets only; nothing is renamed, retired or refused.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Showcase zh-CN debt 320 to 323: answered. The new walk measured the three already-authored titles (`showcase_task.project` Tasks, `showcase_project.account` Projects, `showcase_invoice.account` Invoices) as untranslated; the diff translates each beside its label (任务 / 项目 / 发票) and the new `showcase_business_unit.parent` title (下级单元). `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` still reads 320 for the showcase, the ratchet is one-sided (a grown count fails, an equal one passes), and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` plus the PR's own `check:i18n-coverage` rerun on a2ca53a2 read none new. No baseline edit was owed.
- Skills-docs follow-up for `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:162`: verified, the `fields.{field_name}` row stops at `inlineTitle`; `skills/**` is Tier H, so the one-cell edit cannot ride this PR. The report says `noted, not filed` and the PR's `Skills-docs:` line names no card, where the precedent named #26759 before merge. Escalated to the seat as should-fix 1 below.
- `spec check:generated` exit 1 on the first round (heap OOM in the test-typecheck re-measure), green at an 8192 heap and on the rerun: a box condition, not a diff finding; the committed `test-typecheck-debt.json` is untouched and `check:test-typecheck` reads OK. Accepted.
- Three exit 3 prerequisites (teardown fixture commit, skill-examples and dual-build dists): fetched or built, then rerun exit 0. Accepted.
- `dogfood_battery: n/a`: right, no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.
- `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`: nothing to escalate; no secret, no door opened.

### ④ Design judgment

- Packaged-base rule: the overlay is the `inlineTitle` block with the slot name swapped: `if (!valueOverridesPackagedBase(packagedField, 'relatedListTitle', def.relatedListTitle))` then `lookupObjectFieldAttr(..., 'relatedListTitle', opts)`, assigned only when non-empty. A tenant-re-authored title keeps its text (test `yields to a title the tenant re-authored`), a field the base does not declare counts as diverged (`packagedObjectField` returns `{}`), and no base means the catalog applies. No fallback to the child's plural label anywhere: an authored title with no entry keeps `Amendments`, and a field with neither gains no key. Exact.
- Bundle address: `objects.CHILD.fields.FIELD.relatedListTitle`, on the child. Right, because `deriveRelatedLists` walks `child.fields` for the FK that points at the parent (:367-389) and reads `fieldDef.relatedListTitle` off that child field; for the card's self-lookup the child is the parent, so the address is `objects.clm_contract.fields.renewed_from.relatedListTitle`.
- Reach to side card and body table: verified in the live tree. `RecordDetailView.tsx:2245` calls `deriveRelatedLists(objectDef, objects, …)`; `objects` is `allObjects` from `AppContent.tsx:551`, the app bundle's object members (answered through `createMetaItemAnswer`, translation included, per the bundle-routes docblock) or the `/meta/object` list (`translateMetaList` :3024 runs `translateMetadataDocument` per element). The client sends `Accept-Language` on every request (:7836). One descriptor per FK carries `title` and `isPrimary`; `RecordDetailView.tsx:4006-4010` takes `titleOverride` before the plural-label fallback and sets `isBody = isPrimary`; `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:961-990` splits that one `related[]` into body tables and side cards and `relatedNode` copies `title: rel.title` (:937) onto both. So the served, translated `relatedListTitle` is the only text either surface draws. The dev's no-ui-slice claim holds; `relatedListTitle` has no other console reader outside the metadata-admin and studio inspectors.
- Derived list with no authored `relatedListTitle`: a bundle entry is still served onto it (test `serves an entry on a field that authors no title`), so an app can title the list per locale from the bundle alone, but `os i18n extract` never scaffolds that key and `os i18n check` never demands it. The card's symptom therefore closes only after hotclm authors `relatedListTitle` on `clm_contract.renewed_from` (or writes the zh-CN entry by hand) and adds the bundle key; the platform half, the capability the card asks for, is complete. This is the limitation the card's author should hear in the closing comment (should-fix 2), not a gap in the fix.
- Metadata-protocol echo: `restoreTranslatedEchoes` iterates `FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS` generically against the stored row translated in every locale of the bundle, so adding the key is the whole wiring; the new test pins the zh-CN echo restored to `Renewals` with `fields.renewed_from.relatedListTitle` in `restored`. Right, and the `packagedBase` pass-through means a diverged title is no translation's source, matching the read side.
- Tried to break it: an empty-string bundle entry is skipped (`candidate.length > 0`), so it cannot blank a title; the multi-FK suffix in `deriveRelatedLists` only fires when `title` is absent, so a translated title on one of two FKs leaves the other's suffix intact; the picklist `options` branch is untouched; array-shaped and record-shaped `fields` both pass through `translateField`. Nothing found that reaches must-fix.
- The card's other proposed shape (a field group's translated `label` drawn as the body table's title) is explicitly out of scope and is not drawn today; the card asked for either, and the chosen one is the `inlineTitle` precedent.

Findings:
- should-fix 1: file the Tier H follow-up for `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:162` (add `relatedListTitle` to the `fields.{field_name}` row) and name its number on the PR's `Skills-docs:` line, as #26757 did with #26759. Seat action, no diff change.
- should-fix 2: the closing comment on #29942 should give hotclm the two-line recipe (author `relatedListTitle: 'Renewals'` on `clm_contract.renewed_from`, write `objects.clm_contract.fields.renewed_from.relatedListTitle: '续签合同'`), and say that a bundle entry alone also titles the list but is invisible to `os i18n check`. Seat action, no diff change.
- must-fix: none.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：翻译包新增字段槽位 `objects.子对象.fields.字段.relatedListTitle`。`translateObject` 把它覆盖到下发给控制台的子对象字段上，规则与 `inlineTitle` 相同（包括 packaged-base 让位）。`os i18n extract` 会生成这个键，`os i18n check` 把它计入字段桶，对象保存时会把下发的译文还原成源文。
- 为什么改：记录页 v3 上，关联列表的标题只能来自 `relatedListTitle`（纯字符串）或子对象的名称。所以 zh-CN 下，自引用 lookup（合同续签自合同）的侧卡标题显示为「合同」，和记录本身同名。如果写英文 `relatedListTitle`，中文用户又都会看到英文。
- 风险与回滚：纯加宽，只新增一个可选键，没有默认值。没写这个键的包和对象，行为不变。已写的标题如果包里没有对应条目，保留原文，不会被换成子对象名称。spec、cli、metadata-protocol 三个包为 minor。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 中 `translateField` 的 `relatedListTitle` 段，以及 `translation.zod.ts` 的 `FieldTranslationSchema.relatedListTitle`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-field-related-list-title.test.ts`，预期 8 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：卡片的 zh-CN 自引用场景已经能翻译。控制台侧卡和正文表格都读取下发的、已翻译的子对象，fable 复审已按代码路径逐段核实，因此不需要另开 ui 卡。fable 契约复审 PASS，CI 全绿。同意落地。skills 文档的跟进已另立卡 #29990。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `a2ca53a2eab3155f6001717bb6c7e3b7647b0da8`

- **Shape:** 13 files, +330 −7.
  - New `FieldTranslationSchema.relatedListTitle`, and its `translateField` overlay. The overlay mirrors `inlineTitle`: the same `valueOverridesPackagedBase` guard, no fallback to the child's label, and an empty bundle entry skipped.
  - CLI `i18n-extract` emits the key, and a walk test covers it.
  - metadata-protocol `FIELD_TEXT_SLOTS` gains the key, so the save door restores the served translation; pinned.
  - Showcase: the self-lookup `showcase_business_unit.parent` is authored and pinned to zh-CN 「下级单元」, and the 3 already-authored showcase titles get zh-CN entries.
  - Authorable-surface regenerated; the references page and changeset updated.
- **Premise measured:** at `origin/main` `c92b8872`, `FieldTranslationSchema` had no `relatedListTitle`. The console reads `fieldDef.relatedListTitle` from the served child object (`deriveRelatedLists.ts` ≈:388).
- **Gates (check-runs at this head):** 69 check-runs, 59 success, 10 skipped, 0 red; `mergeable_state: clean`. Dev sweep: 108 derived, 108 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The spec, metadata-protocol, cli-unit and showcase suites are green, and one ablation turns 4 tests red.
- **Contract review:** record 6618628597, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, schema face, this head, VERDICT PASS, no must-fix. It verified the console path end to end: `RecordDetailView.tsx` → `AppContent.tsx` `allObjects`, which goes through `translateMetadataDocument`, → `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, which draws the one descriptor's `title` on both side cards and body tables. So no ui slice is owed. `api-surface`, `export-origins` and the liveness and strictness ledgers correctly do not move (no new export, no new group).
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: added`; `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` minor. ADR-0087 is not owed on a non-breaking changeset.
- **Accepted deviations:** none. The 3 extra showcase zh-CN entries pay down coverage debt the new walk surfaced (320 → 323 before the fix; the baseline stays 320 under the one-sided ratchet).
- **Carried:**
  - Review should-fix 1: the Skills-docs follow-up is filed as #29990 (Blocked-by this PR), and the body's `Skills-docs:` line names it.
  - Review should-fix 2: the card's landing note gives hotclm the recipe.
  - `Skills-docs: follow-up owed #29990`.
- **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 29989`: 0 of 13 paths; 337 lines, under 3000). Ready plus auto-merge.
